{{Quote|Ben, maybe Nanna can take you to the pilots' lounge for some Fizzer.|Mara Jade Skywalker to Ben Skywalker|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Fizzer''' was a type of food associated with [[kyleme]] and available in a [[Color/Legends|blue]] giant size. It was available at the pilots' lounge of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade Skywalker]] suggested that her son, [[Ben Skywalker]], to go to the pilots' lounge with his [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] [[Nanna]]. When Ben refused, his cousin [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] convinced him to go and accompanied him.<ref name="JK" />
